notes: Commencement document (Schedule TO-I plus Offer to Purchase and Letter of Transmittal); no results fields. Primary event is the 60% tender at 99% of NAV. A second event is listed because the filing also states the terms of three Subsequent Conditional Tender Offers (Q4 of each of 2022, 2023 and 2024; up to 10% at 98% of NAV; triggered if the average discount, on VWAP and NAV over business days from January to August of that year, exceeds 10%); the filing says the Offer to Purchase does not itself relate to those offers. window_start/window_end are null because the window is stated only as months ('from January to August of that year', for each of 2022-2024). trigger_origin/origin: the Offer and conditional tenders arose from the May 12, 2021 agreement between EVM and Saba Capital Management (Saba agreed to vote for the new advisory agreement, tender all but one of its shares, and not solicit proxies; EVM reimburses Saba $75,000 of proxy costs; a Standstill Agreement dated May 12, 2021 is Exhibit (d)(i)); the background is Morgan Stanley's acquisition of Eaton Vance Corp. (adviser's parent), so merger_related is an alternative reading. The Offer was conditioned on shareholder approval of the New Agreement, which was met on June 24, 2021, so shareholder_approval is not listed among open conditions. conditions are from Section 13: asset-coverage coded 'other'; banking moratorium and credit-limitation folded into market_disruption; fiduciary-duty into board_discretion. Not conditioned on any minimum number of Shares. commencement_date is the Offer to Purchase date; the excerpt does not otherwise state the opening day. Shares outstanding as of June 23, 2021: 37,866,607; NAV $6.8923 (the Summary's '$ 6.8234' is 99% of that NAV, mislabelled as NAV). The Summary Term Sheet names State Street as credit-agreement lender while Section 8 names Citibank, N.A.; not a schema field. Excerpt ends early in the Letter of Transmittal instructions.
